intro: This document provides an essential overview of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) product migration status to the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE). It presents detailed statistics on product onboarding progress, highlighting newly integrated datasets and incremental updates across various access services like S3, STAC, and OpenEO. The report includes a dynamic, interactive table showcasing the complete CLMS portfolio's migration status, alongside a breakdown of file-level statistics and the methodology used for tracking service availability. This enables scientists, regulators, and data engineers to quickly assess the current state and plan for data access.
